notes: Phase 2A intentionally uses the narrow 47-row Fandom Reward Item scope approved by the parent.
Rank unlock items, code items, currency items, current pass rows, and broad Achievement Collection rows are excluded.
Free price values were not used as availability. Availability is normalized separately from source route using obtainable, available, and available_status fields where present.
Scarlett Fierce Top route is derived from item body text because the source infobox lacks from/obtainability.
Scarlett Fierce Skirt has an event quest requirement but no explicit obtainable/available flag in the infobox, so availability is labeled Limited-time route and source confidence is medium.
Parent route fix needed before public render: add a dress-to-impress-reward-items override that groups by catalogSection and hides source/audit fields.
